# Security Policy

Face images are sensitive personal data. Report vulnerabilities involving data
exposure, path traversal, unsafe uploads, model tampering, or camera permission
handling through a private GitHub security advisory for this repository.

Supported releases are the latest release on the default branch. This local-first
application does not provide authentication, multi-user isolation, liveness
detection, or production identity verification.

Never include real identity documents, unredacted face images, credentials,
database files, or model weights in a public report.
